Chapter 155 - 155 Disrupting the Country and its People; Renting an Office Building!

155 Disrupting the Country and its People; Renting an Office Building!

A day apart felt like three years!

Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan had not seen each other for a month or two. This made them feel like lovers who had finally met after not seeing each other for many years.

The two of them hugged for a long time, but they did not want to separate.

At this moment, Qin Yuxuan’s stomach suddenly let out a low growl.

Her face could not help but blush. Under the setting sun, her skin was like a translucent jade, very beautiful.

Lin Fan smiled. “Are you hungry? Let’s go eat something first.”

Qin Yuxuan nodded.

JE Restaurant was located on the beach of Modu. It was one of the most luxurious Western restaurants in Modu.

The environment was elegant and quiet.

The decoration was luxurious and heavy.

Sitting in the restaurant, one could take in the scenery of the beach.

While tasting the delicacies, they admired the scenery… Coupled with the elegant and luxurious environment, it gave people the ultimate enjoyment.

Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan looked at each other and smiled sweetly.

As the soft music played in JE Restaurant, the best pan-fried foie gras, top-grade snails, black truffle, and high-grade black caviar… Many delicacies were served.

Lin Fan poured the 1982 Lafite into a wine glass. Then, he raised his glass with Qin Yuxuan and clinked it lightly.

Good wine entered his throat, accompanied by delicious food and his lover.

Everything… was so beautiful.

…

Shangri-La Hotel, presidential suite.

Perhaps it was because she had drunk, Qin Yuxuan kept her head down, her pretty face flushing red.

Lin Fan looked at her bashful face. She was just like a cute little rabbit, and his heart was filled with love.

“Are you sleepy? Let’s go take a shower.”

Immediately, the sound of water continued throughout the night.

…

The next day.

The sun was high in the sky, and a huge plane flew across the sky.

Qin Yuxuan slowly opened her eyes.

Lin Fan caressed her soft hair and said, “You’re awake? You worked hard yesterday. Eat something to replenish your strength.”

When Qin Yuxuan heard this, a blush appeared on her snow-white face. It was as if the Lafite from last night had made her a little dizzy again.

After washing up, Qin Yuxuan ate a big bowl of seafood noodles and drank a cup of soy milk. Her pretty face revealed a satisfied expression.

After dinner, she habitually took out her phone and scrolled through the messages.

Qin Yuxuan suddenly realized that her mentor had sent a lot of messages to the group yesterday.

Kong Ling: [Students, do you know? Just a moment ago, our economics almost produced a theorem formula in our school! You should understand what this means.

[This means that our school is very likely to produce a Nobel Prize in Economics!

[I’ve never seen such a talented boy in mathematics!

[But that guy gave up because of his girlfriend’s phone call!

[Really… I’m so angry! No wonder so many people said that women can bring disaster to a country and its people! This is a living example! Students, be vigilant!]

…

When Qin Yuxuan saw this, she said in surprise, “Because of his girlfriend’s phone call, he gave up on deducing the economic theorem formula? How could he do this?!”

When Lin Fan heard this, he suddenly felt that this sentence sounded a little familiar.

He could not help but stretch his neck and look at Qin Yuxuan’s phone screen.

“His girlfriend is really a disaster!” Qin Yuxuan continued.

Qin Yuxuan was a graduate student in economics and Kong Ling’s student. She was greatly influenced by Kong Ling.

She was very clear about the meaning of solving an economic theorem formula.

If one had a theorem formula, many problems would be easily solved.

Besides, the Nobel Prize represented supreme honor!

“Cough, cough, cough!”

Lin Fan started coughing.

Disrupting the country and its people?

Lin Fan wondered if he should tell Qin Yuxuan that this woman who could bring disaster to the country was herself.

He did not know… what expression she would have.

Qin Yuxuan patted Lin Fan’s back gently and said, “Lin Fan, are you alright?”

“No… I’m fine,” Lin Fan waved his hand and said.

“Oh right, what did you say you wanted to discuss with me yesterday?”

At the mention of this matter, Qin Yuxuan could not help but sit up straight and say, “Originally, I wanted to return to Jiangbei after graduation.

“In that case, I can always be with you.

“However, a few days ago, my two seniors invited me to start an investment company in Modu…My mentor is also more supportive of this matter.

“So, I wanted to ask for your opinion.”

Qin Yuxuan was not just a pretty face. She had many ambitions.

It could be seen from her continuous learning until she pursued a master’s degree in economics.

“Jiangbei isn’t far from Modu. If I want to see you, I can come over anytime, just like yesterday.

“Just do what you want to do.”

Qin Yuxuan threw herself into Lin Fan’s arms and said, “Lin Fan, thank you.”

“Silly girl, supporting your career is what I should do.” Lin Fan smiled and said, “Oh right, where are you guys planning to set up your company?”

“My two seniors have arranged to go around and inspect the sites before they can confirm it,” said Qin Yuxuan.

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll accompany you.”

“Okay!” Qin Yuxuan said happily.

Then, Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan arrived at a Starbucks.

People often said that birds of a feather flock together, and this was very reasonable.

At this moment, two women in white shirts with beautiful facial features and voluptuous figures were holding coffee and flipping through information.

They… They were Qin Yuxuan’s two seniors.

Although there was still a gap between their figures and appearances compared to Qin Yuxuan, their looks could definitely get more than 85 points… They might not be considered great beauties, but they were still very rare.

“Yuxuan, you’re here?”

“Have you had breakfast?”

The three of them greeted each other.

Qin Yuxuan said, “I’ve already had breakfast… This is my boyfriend, Lin Fan.”

Then, from left to right, she introduced, “This is Senior Lu and Senior Fan.”

Lin Fan said, “Hello.”

Senior Lu teased, “Lin Fan, you’re pretty capable. You actually managed to woo such an outstanding girl like Yuxuan. ”

“This is mainly due to my handsome face,” Lin Fan said.

“Pfft!” Senior Lu almost burst out laughing. “He’s handsome, but he’s also very thick-skinned.”

Senior Fan did not interrupt.

She flipped through the documents in her hands for a while and said, “Let’s go. Let’s hurry up and look at the office buildings nearby. Then, we’ll discuss where to rent.”

Senior Lu and Qin Yuxuan nodded as well. After all, this was the reason why they came out today.
